TRAVEL INSURANCE POLICY WORDING
Issued by Northstar Underwriting
In this policy, "the Insurer" means Northstar Underwriting and "the Insured Person" means the person named in the schedule.

§ 1  Definitions
(1) Dental treatment means treatment of the teeth or gums.
(2) Excursions and tickets means pre-booked excursions, tours, and event or theatre tickets.
(3) Hazardous activity means skydiving, motor racing, or trekking or climbing above 4,500 metres.
(4) Physiotherapy means treatment of muscles and joints by a physiotherapist.
(5) Pre-existing condition means any illness or injury for which the Insured Person received treatment or advice in the 6 months before the policy start date.
(6) Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
(7) Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows the Insured Person's details, the covers the Insured Person bought and any extensions.

§ 2  Limits and excess
(1) Baggage and Personal Belongings: limit $2,000 per incident; excess $75 per claim.
(2) Emergency Medical Expenses: limit $25,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
(3) Trip Cancellation: limit $3,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
(4) Travel Delay: limit $500 per incident; excess $50 per claim.
(5) Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the excess is then deducted from the result.

§ 3  Emergency Medical Expenses
(1) The Insurer will pay reasonable and necessary emergency medical costs incurred during the trip.
(2) The most the Insurer will pay for Dental treatment under this section is $250 per incident.
(3) The most the Insurer will pay for Physiotherapy under this section is $500 per incident.
(4) The Insurer will not pay for treatment of a pre-existing condition.
(5) The Insurer will not pay for injury or illness arising from a hazardous activity. This exclusion does not apply if the Adventure Sports extension is shown in the Insured Person's schedule.
(6) The Insurer will not pay for any claim arising from the Insured Person's being under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

§ 4  Trip Cancellation
(1) The Insurer will pay non-refundable travel and accommodation costs if the Insured Person must cancel the trip for a reason beyond the Insured Person's control.
(2) No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 14 days after the policy start date.
(3) The most the Insurer will pay for Excursions and tickets under this section is $300 per incident.
(4) The Insurer will not pay for cancellation caused by a strike or other event that had been publicly announced before the Insured Person bought the policy.
(5) The Insurer will not pay for cancellation because the Insured Person no longer wish to travel.

§ 5  General exclusions
(1) The Insurer will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by the Insured Person.
(2) The Insurer will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
(3) The Insurer will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.

§ 6  Making a claim
(1) The Insured Person must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
(2) The Insured Person must notify the Insurer of a claim within 30 days of the incident. The Insurer will not pay any claim notified after that time.
(3) The Insurer may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

(2) Vision Care: limit $500 per treatment; deductible $25 per claim.

(2) The Plan will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits the Plan from paying.

(3) The Member must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.

(1) The Plan's helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.

(1) The Plan will communicate with the Member in English.
